privacy.consent_title: Your data stays on your phone
privacy.consent_sub: Before you start, here is what EasySpot does with your information.
privacy.p1_title: Location only while you use the app
privacy.p1_text: Used to save your spot and find it again. Never in the background.
privacy.p2_text: Your spots and places are not sent to us or to anyone else.
privacy.p3_title: No ads, no tracking, no account
privacy.p3_text: Nothing is sold or used for analytics.
privacy.p4_text: To show an address, your phone's own map service (Google, Huawei or Apple) looks up the coordinates.
privacy.agree: I have read and agree to the Privacy Policy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s_collect: EasySpot collects only what it needs to save and find your spots: your location while the app is open, and the details you type (level, zone, spot, name, note, paid time).
privacy.s_location: Approximate and precise location are used only while the app is in use. EasySpot never reads your location in the background.
privacy.s_storage: On this phone only, until you delete it or uninstall the app. There is no account and no EasySpot server.
privacy.s_services: To turn coordinates into a street name, the app asks your phone's own geocoding service (Google, Huawei or Apple). On phones with Google Play services, location is measured by Google's location service. These services work under their own privacy policies.
privacy.s_reminders: If you set paid time, EasySpot schedules a reminder on your phone. Nothing is sent over the internet.
privacy.s_sharing: We do not share, sell or rent your data. You can share a spot yourself with the Share button.
privacy.s_rights: You can delete any spot at any time, clear the app's data in your phone settings or uninstall the app. You can allow or deny location access at any time in your phone settings.
privacy.s_changes: If this policy changes, the app will show the new version and ask you to agree again.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.s_what: A personal tool to save where you parked and places you return to. You choose and enter every location yourself.
terms.s_data: Everything you save stays on your phone and belongs to you.
terms.s_guarantee: Positions come from your phone and can be inaccurate. EasySpot does not check whether parking is allowed, paid or still valid. You are responsible for following local parking rules.
terms.s_liability: The app is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for parking fines, towing, missed reminders or inaccurate positions.
terms.s_changes: If these terms change, the app will show the new version.
